sourceChecks.text: Then Joab said to the Cushite, “Go, tell the king what you have seen!” The Cushite bowed himself to Joab, and ran.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文はクシュ人と呼ぶ使者を指し、固有名を示さない。文脈上、ヨアブが命じた同じ使者を指す。

sourceChecks.text: Then Ahimaaz the son of Zadok said yet again to Joab, “But come what may, please let me also run after the Cushite.” Joab said, “Why do you want to run, my son, since you will have no reward for the news?”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文はクシュ人と呼ぶ使者を指し、固有名を示さない。文脈上、ヨアブが命じた同じ使者を指す。

sourceChecks.text: “But come what may,” he said, “I will run.” He said to him, “Run!” Then Ahimaaz ran by the way of the Plain, and outran the Cushite.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文はクシュ人と呼ぶ使者を指し、固有名を示さない。文脈上、ヨアブが命じた同じ使者を指す。

sourceChecks.text: Behold, the Cushite came. The Cushite said, “Good news for my lord the king, for the LORD has avenged you today of all those who rose up against you.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文はクシュ人と呼ぶ使者を指し、固有名を示さない。文脈上、ヨアブが命じた同じ使者を指す。

sourceChecks.text: The king said to the Cushite, “Is it well with the young man Absalom?” The Cushite answered, “May the enemies of my lord the king, and all who rise up against you to do you harm, be as that young man is.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文はクシュ人と呼ぶ使者を指し、固有名を示さない。文脈上、ヨアブが命じた同じ使者を指す。
